app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

title.example: Efina set to leave Gen.G as free agent

winner.description: team1/team2 are the head_to_head teams, left and right

title.example: T1 Academy's full roster released ahead of 2027 season

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns one VLR.gg event: name, series, dates, prize, location and the participating teams with ids. Use vlr-event-matches for its matches and vlr-team for a team.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR event id from vlr-events
parameters.name: id

get.summary: VLR.gg Valorant event detail and participating teams

get.description: Returns the agent pick-rate matrix of one VLR.gg event: for the whole event and for each map, the number of games, the attack-side and defense-side round win rates and the share of games in which each agent was played. Also returns, per map, each team's agents used and the agents picked in each of its matches (compositions). Use it to see an event's meta; vlr-stats gives per-player agent usage.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR event id from vlr-events
parameters.name: id

get.summary: VLR.gg Valorant event agent pick rates by map

get.description: Returns every match of one VLR.gg event (upcoming, live and completed) with teams, scores, stage and whether stats or VODs exist. Use vlr-match with a returned `id` for map detail.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR event id from vlr-events
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Stage id from the stages list of an earlier response (a week, group or bracket round); omit for every stage
parameters.name: series_id

parameters.description: Match group; one of completed, upcoming; omit for both
parameters.name: group

get.description: Returns the player statistics table of one VLR.gg event (rating, ACS, K:D, KAST, ADR, per-round rates, first kills, clutches, totals) for every player who appeared, optionally for one `side` (`all`, `t` attack, `ct` defend). For league-wide filtered statistics use vlr-stats.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR event id from vlr-events
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Side; one of all, t, ct; defaults to all
parameters.name: side

parameters.description: Comma-separated agent roles; any of controller, initiator, sentinel, duelist
parameters.name: role

parameters.description: Comma-separated agents, for example jett,sage; the same 29 agents as vlr-stats
parameters.name: agent

parameters.description: Comma-separated map names, for example ascent,bind; the same 13 maps as vlr-stats
parameters.name: map

parameters.description: Comma-separated stage ids from the stages list of vlr-event-matches
parameters.name: stage

parameters.description: Minimum rounds played; 0 to 100000
parameters.name: min_rounds

parameters.description: Sort column, the same set as vlr-stats; defaults to rating
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Sort direction; one of desc, asc; defaults to desc
parameters.name: dir

get.description: Returns Valorant events from VLR.gg: ongoing, upcoming and completed events with prize pool, dates and region flag. Filter by `tier` (`all`, `vct`, `vcl`, `t3`, `gc`, `cg`, `off`) and `region` (`all`, `americas`, `emea`, `pacific`, `china`); `page` pages through completed events. Use vlr-event with a returned `id`.

parameters.description: Event tier; one of all, vct, vcl, t3, gc, cg, off; defaults to all
parameters.name: tier

parameters.description: Event region; one of all, americas, emea, pacific, china; defaults to all
parameters.name: region

parameters.description: 1-based page number; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

get.description: Returns the VLR.gg forum directory: each category with slug, name, group, description, thread and post counts and the last poster, time and thread. `slug` is one of `valorant-discussion`, `off-topic`, `site-feedback`; use it as `category` in vlr-forum-threads.

Returns a page (30) of VLR.gg forum threads, newest activity first, for one `category` (`valorant-discussion`, `off-topic`, `site-feedback`) or the combined list: title, reply count, pinned flag, category, author, post age, frags (score) and the last poster. Thread titles and usernames are public community content; thread bodies and replies are not returned.

parameters.description: Forum category; one of valorant-discussion, off-topic, site-feedback; omit for the combined list
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: 1-based page number; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Order; one of hot, new, top; omit for the site default (recent activity)
parameters.name: sort

get.description: Returns one VLR.gg match: event and stage, exact UTC start time, status (`final`, `live`, `upcoming`), format such as `Bo3`, both teams with series score, the pick/ban note, and every map with picker, round scores split into attack, defend and overtime, duration and per-player lines (agents, rating, ACS, K/D/A, KAST, ADR, headshot percent, first kills and deaths). `all_maps_players` holds the aggregate across maps. Also returns the teams' head-to-head history and each team's recent results. Player fields are omitted when VLR has not published them yet. Use vlr-match-economy, vlr-match-performance and vlr-match-rounds for the economy, kill-matrix and round-by-round tabs.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR match id from vlr-matches, vlr-results or vlr-event-matches
parameters.name: id

get.summary: VLR.gg Valorant match detail and player statistics

get.description: Returns the Economy tab of one VLR.gg match for every map and for the whole match: each team's pistol rounds, pistol conversion and bonus-round records, win records by buy level (`eco` under 10k, `half` 10k to 18k, `full` 18k and over) against each opponent buy level, and round by round banks, loadout values, buy levels, the winner and the winning side. `available` is false while VLR has not published the tab, which is normal for a match that just ended.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR match id from vlr-matches, vlr-results or vlr-event-matches
parameters.name: id

get.description: Returns the Performance tab of one VLR.gg match for every map and for the whole match: player-versus-player kill matrices (overall kills and deaths, first kills and deaths, and Operator kills and deaths) and per-player advanced stats (2K to 5K multi-kills, 1v1 to 1v5 clutches, econ rating, spike plants and defuses). `available` is false while VLR has not published the tab.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR match id from vlr-matches, vlr-results or vlr-event-matches
parameters.name: id

get.description: Returns the round log (the 2D replay data) of one VLR.gg match for every map that has one: for each round the score after it, the winner, the attacking team, every player's agent, credits left, spend, armor and weapon, and the ordered events (kills with weapon, spike plants and defuses) with their round clock. `available` is false when VLR has no replay for the match.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR match id from vlr-matches, vlr-results or vlr-event-matches
parameters.name: id

get.description: Returns the Valorant match schedule from VLR.gg: upcoming and live matches grouped by day with both teams, country flags, event, stage, ETA and whether stats or VODs exist. `status` is `upcoming`, `live` or `completed`. `time_label` is the time shown on the site, whose timezone is not guaranteed; use vlr-match for an exact UTC start time. Use vlr-results for finished matches.

parameters.description: 1-based page number; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

get.summary: VLR.gg upcoming and live Valorant matches

get.description: Returns the latest Valorant esports news headlines from VLR.gg, 30 per page, with title, summary line, date, author and country flag. Page back through older news with `page`.

parameters.description: 1-based page number; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

get.description: Returns one VLR.gg news article: title, author, UTC publish time, the body as plain-text paragraphs, the teams, players and events it links to (type `team`, `player` or `event`, with id, slug and name), external links and image URLs. Reader comments are not included. Forum threads share the same numeric id space, so an id that is a thread, or does not exist, returns not found. Take `id` from vlr-news.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR news article id from vlr-news
parameters.name: id

get.description: Returns one VLR.gg player: alias, real name, country, social links, agent-by-agent statistics (use, rounds, rating, ACS, K:D, KAST, ADR, KPR, APR and first kills), current and past teams and recent results.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR player id from vlr-team or vlr-stats
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Window of the agent statistics; one of all, 30d, 60d, 90d; omit for the site default
parameters.name: timespan

get.summary: VLR.gg Valorant player profile and agent statistics

get.description: Returns a player's match history from VLR.gg, 50 per page, newest first: event, stage, the player's team and opponent, series score, win or loss and date. Use vlr-match with a returned `id` for the player's map statistics.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR player id from vlr-team or vlr-stats
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: 1-based page number; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

get.description: Returns VLR.gg's team ranking for one region: rank, team, country, rating, record, streak, earnings and last match. `region` is one of north-america, europe, brazil, asia-pacific, korea, china, japan, la-s, la-n, oceania, mena, gc, collegiate. `limit` returns the top 1 to 250 teams (default 50).

parameters.description: Ranking region; one of north-america, europe, brazil, asia-pacific, korea, china, japan, la-s, la-n, oceania, mena, gc, collegiate; defaults to north-america
parameters.name: region

parameters.description: Number of top teams to return, 1 to 250; defaults to 50
parameters.name: limit

get.summary: VLR.gg Valorant team rankings by region

get.description: Returns completed Valorant matches from VLR.gg, newest first, 50 per page, with final series scores, winner flags, event, stage and whether stats or VODs are listed. For a completed match `eta` is the time since it ended. Use vlr-match with a returned `id` for map-by-map player statistics.

parameters.description: 1-based page number; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

get.description: Searches VLR.gg for teams, events and players by name and returns every match on one page: kind, id, name, canonical URL and logo, plus the event date range and prize pool and, for retired teams, the `inactive` flag and the team that replaced them (`successor`). `type` limits the search to `teams`, `events` or `players`; the default `all` returns all three groups with per-group counts. Use the returned id with vlr-team, vlr-event or vlr-player.

parameters.description: Search text, 1 to 100 characters
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Result group; one of all, teams, events, players; defaults to all
parameters.name: type

get.summary: VLR.gg search for teams, events and players

get.description: Returns VLR.gg's player statistics table (100 rows per page): agents played, maps, rounds, rating, ACS, K:D, KAST, ADR, KPR, APR, first-kill and clutch rates and totals. Filter with comma-separated `tier` (vct, vcl, t3, gc, cg, off), `region` (americas, emea, pacific, china, intl), `role` (controller, initiator, sentinel, duelist), `agent` and `map` names, plus `timespan` (all, 30d, 60d, 90d or a year 2020 to 2026), `side` (all, t, ct), `min_rounds` and `min_rating`; sort with `sort` and `dir`.

parameters.description: Comma-separated tiers from vct, vcl, t3, gc, cg, off; site default vct
parameters.name: tier

parameters.description: Comma-separated regions from americas, emea, pacific, china, intl
parameters.name: region

parameters.description: Side; one of all, t, ct
parameters.name: side

parameters.description: Comma-separated roles from controller, initiator, sentinel, duelist
parameters.name: role

parameters.description: Comma-separated agents from astra, brimstone, clove, harbor, miks, omen, viper, breach, fade, gekko, kayo, skye, sova, tejo, chamber, cypher, deadlock, killjoy, sage, veto, vyse, iso, jett, neon, phoenix, raze, reyna, waylay, yoru
parameters.name: agent

parameters.description: Comma-separated maps from abyss, bind, corrode, haven, lotus, summit, sunset, ascent, breeze, fracture, icebox, pearl, split
parameters.name: map

parameters.description: Minimum rounds played; site default 100
parameters.name: min_rounds

parameters.description: First day of a custom date range, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); requires to and replaces timespan
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Last day of a custom date range, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); requires from and replaces timespan
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Sort column; one of rating, maps, rnd, acs, kd, kast, adr, kpr, apr, fkfd, fkpr, fdpr, hsp, clp, cl, kmax, k, d, a, fk, fd; defaults to rating
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Sort direction; one of asc, desc; defaults to desc
parameters.name: dir

parameters.description: 1-based page number; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

get.summary: VLR.gg Valorant player statistics with filters

get.description: Returns one VLR.gg team: name, tag, country, links, the roster (players with captain flag, plus coach, manager and analyst staff, each with a player id) and recent matches with scores and results, plus related news. Use vlr-player with a roster `id`.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR team id from vlr-rankings, vlr-event or vlr-match
parameters.name: id

get.summary: VLR.gg Valorant team profile and roster

get.description: Returns a team's per-map record from VLR.gg: maps played, win percent, wins and losses, plus attack-side and defense-side round win percent, rounds won and lost and first-round counts. Use it to compare map strengths; vlr-team-matches lists the underlying matches.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR team id from vlr-rankings, vlr-event or vlr-match
parameters.name: id

get.summary: VLR.gg Valorant team map win rates

get.description: Returns a team's complete match history from VLR.gg, 50 per page, newest first: event, stage, opponent, series score, win or loss and date. Use vlr-match with a returned `id` for map detail, or vlr-team for the roster.

parameters.description: Numeric VLR team id from vlr-rankings, vlr-event or vlr-match
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: 1-based page number; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Match group; one of completed (default), upcoming
parameters.name: group
